_readme: Every staged OCR file this project holds, read off the ocr-staging branches
themselves on 21 Sep 2026 by tools/harvest_ocr_receipts.py -- not from
workflow exit codes, which reported success over 5,342 pages that were
refused. One row per staged file: which engine, which source PDF, when it
was written, what its own usage block claims, and every page-level error.
'receipts' is empty for every row here and will not be empty again. Sarvam
returns a job_id for each chunk and sarvam_docai.py logged it and dropped
it, so none of the 20,452 pages billed in September can be named back to
Sarvam. From 21 Sep the job id, its duration and its outcome are written
